tables.title: Electric Power Production in South Korea, August 1945 to April 1948
tables.source_note: SOURCE: Bureau of Utilities, Department of Commerce.
tables.totals_check: Checked hydro total (sum of four plants), steam total and Total Gen. for every month. Most agree within 0.1 (rounding): hydro Aug 1945, Mar/May/Jun/Jul/Oct 1946, Jun/Nov 1947 and Apr 1948 differ by 0.1 and steam Apr 1948 by 0.1. Larger disagreements: Sep 1945 hydro printed 18.6 vs sum of plants 8.5 (and Total Gen. printed 8.6); Feb 1947 hydro printed 12.0 vs sum 7.0 (printed Chung Pyong 2.6), and Feb 1947 steam total printed 7.4 vs sum of plants 2.4; Apr 1948 Total Gen. printed 33.7 vs hydro 18.9 + steam 14.1 = 33.0. Apr 1946 Total Gen. 18.9 vs 18.4+.4 = 18.8 and Nov 1947 17.6 vs 9.6+8.1 = 17.7 are rounding differences. Remaining rows agree. Some of the larger disagreements may be misprints in the source or digits too faint to confirm in the scan; transcribed as they appear.
warnings: Sep 1945 hydro total printed 18.6 but plants sum to 8.5 and Total Gen. is 8.6
Feb 1947 hydro total 12.0 does not equal sum of plants 7.0
Feb 1947 steam total 7.4 does not equal Yong Wol 2.2 + Dangin RI 0.2
Apr 1948 Total Gen. 33.7 does not equal 18.9 + 14.1 = 33.0
Dash cells are printed dashes; Dangin RI/steam-total cells such as '.0' and '.3' (May 1946) are as printed
tables.ocr_check: OCR matched the figures I read in the image; image resolution is low so the digits in the flagged rows (Sep 1945, Feb 1947, Apr 1948) were checked but could not be resolved further.
